assumptions.statement: The submitted overall boundary is the organizer-supplied provisional rough geometry and is not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: Every design layer and area metric must be regenerated after an official polygon is released.

assumptions.statement: The three provisional key-area polygons are not proven to align with named stations, roads or parcels.
assumptions.impact: No station-integrated engineering or parcel-level detailed design is claimed; Issue #1029 reports the submitted Dazhongsi polygon centroid roughly 2.26 km from the named station.

assumptions.statement: The authoring agent did not visit the project area.
assumptions.impact: No statement about present-day street conditions, informal use, comfort, safety or local character is treated as field-verified.

assumptions.statement: The authoring agent did not interview residents, workers, merchants, institutions or public agencies.
assumptions.impact: Personas and service needs are design hypotheses; GitHub Issue #1061 is one public critique and does not represent all residents.

assumptions.statement: Official controls, ownership, existing buildings, heritage boundaries, road redlines, utilities, hydrology and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, cost and construction feasibility remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: No operational baseline has been measured for the 12 proposed scenarios.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario starts at G0 and may advance only after its stated baseline is collected by an authorized party.

assumptions.statement: Named actors in the proposal are accountable roles, not confirmed agencies, partners or operators.
assumptions.impact: No pilot starts until a legal entity accepts responsibility, permission, insurance, complaint handling and shutdown duties.

assumptions.statement: No investment, operating budget, revenue or funding commitment is available.
assumptions.impact: Projects are sequenced by evidence and reversibility rather than fabricated cost estimates.

assumptions.statement: Six global institutions are reviewed only for transferable operating mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: No local investment, firm, output or partnership claim is inferred from those cases.

assumptions.statement: Pilots use the minimum necessary data and preserve device-free and staffed service channels.
assumptions.impact: Personal tracking, facial recognition and automated eligibility decisions are outside the proposed design space.

assumptions.statement: The submission contains no third-party photos, map tiles, logos, remote scripts or embedded remote fonts.
assumptions.impact: All diagrams and drawings are generated locally from the submitted concept geometry and original text.
